name: Neo-Grunge Streetwear
description: High-contrast monochrome grunge with a single vibrant neon spot color and vast dark negative space for bold typography.
magic_media_keywords: High contrast monochromatic black and white base, deep shadows, distressed grunge texture, stark juxtaposition, featuring a single vibrant neon spot color (e.g., neon green spray paint or neon accent), edgy underground aesthetic, vast dark negative space for bold typography.
palette_hint: monochrome black/white base (#0A0A0A near-black, #F5F5F5 near-white) plus one high-chroma neon accent (e.g. #39FF14)
best_for: streetwear drops, underground music gigs, and youth-culture campaigns needing gritty monochrome with a neon punch
